@bogwitch: Met a new client, learned about what they're doing, pitched them to a reporter, and snagged an exclusive all in 30 minutes. A new record for me and a high I've been riding all day.

But then I thought about what the client could be thinking.

"30 minutes of work?? Why would someone spend good money for 30 minutes of work? If it was that easy, why would we need your help?"

Because this is the kind of stuff PR people dream of and LIVE for but it happens about 1% of the time. 

Because we spend months, sometimes years, building relationships with reporters before we can routinely snag their attention.

Because we know these reporters well and immediately think of them when the right story crosses our desk.

You're not paying for the time it takes to land the story you wanted. You're paying for the time already spent building the knowledge and the relationships.
